description:
List software anomalies

The software-fingerprinting anomaly feed (spec §6): version downgrades and vendor swaps, both graded `notice`. A `market` carve-out — the general `/v1/anomalies` feed (network) excludes these detectors. Same shape as that feed.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned as `next_cursor` by the previous page.

detector.description: Filter by detector (a software detector; others yield an empty page).

host.description: Filter to anomalies targeting one host.

limit.description: Page size, clamped to [1, 200]. Defaults to 50.

seat.description: Filter to anomalies targeting one seat.

since.description: Only include items at or after this ISO 8601 instant.

name: list_software_anomalies
